Start · lights out and away we go

Standing start from the grid behind the line; the race clock starts at lights-out (5 reds, one per second, then a random hold). Grid: Black 88, Yellow 2, Teal 61, Purple 27, Green 51, White 33, Orange 4, Red 7, Silver 19, Blue 14. Lap 1 arrivals were bunched within ~2 s.

How this race was made

The ten new minis (GT3, LMP, Formula, rally, touring, drift, Group 5, supercar, stock car, hypercar; 15–19.5 cm, wear and stickers), each rendered alone from 1.8 m straight above (480×270, Cycles, 1/120 s blur): two calibration passes, four lanes, a fast pass and two diagonal crossings (+25°, −38°) per car. Passes composited onto the empty track with sensor noise: standing start from lights-out, 10 laps, per-car pace 17.6–18.6 s ±0.3 s, spins, a forced photo finish (1 frame apart, abreast, lap 4) and a three-wide arrival (lap 7). Diagonal crossings only when no other car is near (cars can't pass through each other in a composite).

Engine (this branch): nose timing (blob edge ahead of the centroid, minus the mask rim and half the blur streak), crossing box + velocity on every event; LapIdentity after the camera: conflicts, unnamed crossings, check-line rescues and missing laps decided by each car's lap rhythm. Decisions: engine 100, not counted 6, unknown 1.

Pace: Black 88 18.56, Blue 14 18.15, Green 51 17.96, Orange 4 18.48, Purple 27 17.62, Red 7 18.05, Silver 19 18.55, Teal 61 17.80, White 33 17.99, Yellow 2 18.38 s. Spins: Blue 14 lap 3: +5.4 s (spin), Orange 4 lap 2: +4.0 s (spin), Purple 27 lap 2: +5.6 s (spin), Red 7 lap 4: +4.6 s (spin), Silver 19 lap 9: +4.0 s (spin), White 33 lap 5: +5.0 s (spin).
